exposure: Splenic vessel invasion (categorized by circular degree: no invasion, 0-180deg, 180deg or more)
Splenic artery and vein invasion (one vessel vs. both)
cohort: The study enrolled 249 patients who underwent upfront distal pancreatectomy for pancreatic body or tail cancer from 2005 to 2018.
finding: Splenic vessel invasion was significantly associated with higher recurrence and lower 5-year overall survival rates in patients with pancreatic body or tail cancers.
